title: Charred Pad Thai Spring Rolls
description: A twist on the classic Italian spring rolls, incorporating the bold flavors of Pad Thai. These charred bites are perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Charred vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and onions

ingredients.name: Magically cooked noodles
ingredients.notes: such as Pad Thai-style rice noodles

instructions: Cook the spring roll wrappers according to the package instructions.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the charred vegetables and cook until crispy.
Add the magically cooked noodles, Italian seasonings, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the crispy Thai basil and stir-fry for another minute.
Assemble the spring rolls by placing a tablespoon of the noodle mixture onto a spring roll wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Cook the spring rolls in the air fryer for 5-7 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
